---
title: "Summarising_VCFs"
output: html_document
date: "2025-08-29"
---

```{r}
# Setup ----------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load Annotated VCFs -------------------------------------------
load(file = "~/DPhil/R_Data/Annotated_VCFs_Raw")

# Libraries ------------------------------------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

# Counting Unique Variant Loci per Dataset -----------------------
Unique_Variant_Loci <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_Raw,
  function(df) df[, 1:2] %>% unique()
)

# Create and save plots ------------------------------------------
List_of_Unique_Variant_Loci_Plots <- lapply(names(Unique_Variant_Loci), function(element_name) {

  element <- Unique_Variant_Loci[[element_name]]
  build   <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 5]
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 4] %>%
    str_replace(., "^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")
  speciesANDbuild <- paste(species, build, sep = "_")

  counts <- element %>% count(CHROM)

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(counts, aes(x = reorder(CHROM, n), y = n)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "orange", colour = "black") +
    labs(
      title = element_name,
      x = "Chromosome",
      y = "Unique Variants"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "white"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "white", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(color = "white", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Save each plot individually
  ggsave(
    plot,
    filename = paste0(
      "~/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/1_Summaries/Unique_Variants_per_Chromosome_",
      element_name, ".png"
    ),
    bg = "transparent",
    type = "cairo",
    units = "cm",
    width = ifelse(
      length(unique(counts$CHROM)) < 26,
      length(unique(counts$CHROM)) + 4,
      26 + 4
    ),
    height = 7,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    dpi = 2000
  )

  return(plot)
})

# Combine plots vertically with patchwork ------------------------
# Compute relative heights based on chromosome counts
heights <- sapply(Unique_Variant_Loci, function(df) length(unique(df$CHROM)))

Combined_Unique_Variant_Loci_Plot <- wrap_plots(
  List_of_Unique_Variant_Loci_Plots,
  ncol = 1,            # stack vertically
  heights = heights    # relative heights
) & theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "white"),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)
)

# Save combined patchwork plot
ggsave(
  filename = "~/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/1_Summaries/Combined_Unique_Variants_per_Chromosome.png",
  plot = Combined_Unique_Variant_Loci_Plot,
  bg = "transparent",
  units = "cm",
  width = 40,
  height = sum(heights) / 2,   # total height scales by chromosome count
  dpi = 800
)

# Counting Unique Variants per Dataset ---------------------------
Unique_Variants <- lapply(
  Annotated_VCFs_Raw,
  function(df) df[, 1:4] %>% unique()
)

List_of_Unique_Variants_Plots <- lapply(names(Unique_Variants), function(element_name) {

  element <- Unique_Variants[[element_name]]
  element$variantType <- paste(element$REF, element$ALT, sep = ":")
  build   <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 5]
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 4] %>%
    str_replace(., "^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")
  speciesANDbuild <- paste(species, build, sep = "_")

  counts <- element %>% count(variantType)
  top_counts <- dplyr::top_n(counts, 30, n)

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(top_counts, aes(y = reorder(variantType, n), x = n)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "orange", colour = "black") +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2, unit = "cm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "white"),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "white"),
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "white", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "white")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top", nrow(top_counts), "Common Variants.\n",
                    nrow(counts), "Unique Variants in Total."),
      y = NULL,
      x = "Count"
    )

  ggsave(
    plot,
    filename = paste0(
      "~/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/1_Summaries/Unique_Variants_",
      element_name, ".png"
    ),
    bg = "transparent",
    type = "cairo",
    units = "cm",
    height = 20,
    width = 20,
    create.dir = TRUE,
    dpi = 2000
  )
})
